wire_schema.scope: Every Tauri/JSON request, response and error revision/generation/epoch/count/size/sequence uses U64Decimal when internal type u64. Domain Rust u64 and existing persisted schemas unchanged. Actual design floating-point values remain C1 number policy, not blanket strings.

trace_policy: Every preserved original row has immutable SHA and explicit unchanged or protocol-only amendment; detailed named inputs/call logs in rr fixtures supplement original behavior. No original behavior case removed.
fixture_gate: Each planned test must materialize closed inputs and independent expected byte/call sequence before valid RED. This document supplies exact RR phase examples, not product executable tests.
